title: Bench: capacitance from an RC discharge on an oscilloscope (0D)
description: A capacitor (nominal 470 nF, +-10 %) discharges through a resistor measured with an ohmmeter. An 8-bit oscilloscope with noise and a time-base error records V(t); an exponential fit gives tau and C = tau / R with its uncertainty, compared with the capacitor's true value (the bench's ground truth, hidden from the fit).
